P.P. Naolekar & Lokeshwar Singh Panta
JUDGMENT:
JUDGMENT
O R D E R
TRANSFER PETITION (CIVIL) NO.652 OF 2007 
        Heard learned counsel for the parties. 
        Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, petition for 
dissolution of marriage bearing No. (H.M.A.) 690 of 2007 pending in the 
Court of Sri Gulshan Kumar, ADJ, Rohini Courts, Delhi is transferred to the 
Family Court, Haridwar, which shall try the matter either itself or assign it to 
any other court of competent jurisdiction.  The Family Court/Competent 
Court shall proceed with the case expeditiously and unnecessary 
adjournment shall not be granted to the parties. 
        The transfer petition is, accordingly, allowed.
